segments.text: Some of the greatest discoveries happened by accident.
segments.englishExplanation: Many major scientific breakthroughs occur unexpectedly rather than through deliberate planning.
segments.turkishExplanation: En büyük buluşlardan bazıları tesadüfen gerçekleşti.

segments.text: Before a summer holiday, the scientist Alexander Fleming left his messy lab.
segments.englishExplanation: Before going on summer vacation, scientist Alexander Fleming left his laboratory untidy.
segments.turkishExplanation: Yaz tatilinden önce bilim insanı Alexander Fleming dağınık laboratuvarından ayrıldı.

segments.text: Some dishes of bacteria stayed on the bench.
segments.englishExplanation: Certain bacterial culture plates were left behind on the worktable.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bazı bakteri kapları tezgahın üzerinde kaldı.

segments.text: Although it looked like a failure, he noticed something strange when he came back.
segments.englishExplanation: Even though it seemed like a mistake, he spotted an unusual phenomenon upon his return.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bir başarısızlık gibi görünse de geri döndüğünde garip bir şey fark etti.

segments.text: A mold had grown on one dish, and the bacteria around it had died.
segments.englishExplanation: Mold had developed on a petri dish, killing the surrounding bacteria.
segments.turkishExplanation: Kaplardan birinde küf büyümüştü ve etrafındaki bakteriler ölmüştü.

segments.text: Despite having no plan for this, he wanted to find out why.
segments.englishExplanation: Even without an intentional plan for this result, he was curious to discover the reason.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bunun için bir planı olmamasına rağmen nedenini öğrenmek istedi.

segments.text: That mold led to penicillin, one of the first antibiotics.
segments.englishExplanation: That specific fungus eventually resulted in the creation of penicillin, a pioneering antibiotic.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bu küf, ilk antibiyotiklerden biri olan penisiline yol açtı.

segments.text: So, next time your desk is a mess, don't apologize,
segments.englishExplanation: Therefore, when your workspace is untidy in the future, do not feel bad about it.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bu yüzden, bir dahaki sefere masanız dağınık olduğunda özür dilemeyin,

segments.englishExplanation: You might actually be engaging in scientific discovery.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Used to describe something that happens without planning or intention; by chance.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Planlanmadan, şans eseri gerçekleşen durumları ifade etmek için kullanılır.
learningPoints.exampleEn: I found this great book by accident.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Used to express contrast, showing that an action took place even without prior planning or preparation.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir engel veya hazırlıksızlık olmasına rağmen bir şeyin yapıldığını anlatmak için 'despite' kelimesinden sonra fiile '-ing' eklenir.
learningPoints.exampleEn: Despite having no experience, she did a great job.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Hiç tecrübesi olmamasına rağmen harika bir iş çıkardı.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To cause or result in a particular outcome over time.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Belli bir sonuca veya duruma yol açmak, neden olmak anlamında kullanılır.
learningPoints.exampleEn: Hard work often leads to success.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Çok çalışmak genellikle başarıya yol açar.

quiz.question: In the context of the video, what does the phrase 'led to' mean in this sentence?

issues.message: Learning point ifadesi ("lead to") segment 7'in transcript metninde literal olarak bulunamadı — pedagojik notation/çekim farkı olabilir, yanlış pozitif olasılığı var.
